text:
naiya: Heads up from design review — compact invite rows in org settings are causing confusion: keyboard users land on role chip before the primary Invite action. We should reorder DOM so Invite is after the heading. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ux/compact-invite-2026.png
tom: Agreed. Current visual layout uses flex-reverse so DOM follows visual order. Proposal: change DOM order to heading -> invite -> role -> kebab and use CSS grid for visual placement. Avoid tabindex hacks.
harry: Implementation caveat: e2e selectors and analytics rely on DOM order. We'll update tests; minimal change otherwise. Also ensure focus-visible remains unchanged.
rachel: Copy suggestions: invite aria-label should be "Invite people to <Project Name>" and add an sr-only aria-describedby when a default role will be applied, e.g. "Invite  assigns 'Viewer' role". Role chip SR text should be shortened to "Viewer role".
a11y-bot: Checklist: 1) DOM action order matches logical priority; 2) invite aria-label includes context; 3) sr-only outcome text via aria-describedby; 4) kebab last in tab order; 5) announce SSO toggle changes via aria-live polite; 6) add unit/e2e tests for tab order and aria attributes; 7) verify with NVDA/VoiceOver and axe-core.
naiya: Can we land this in beta? Small PR with before/after keyboard GIFs and SR transcripts for design review.
tom: I'll put up the PR and tag @rachel for copy + @harry for QA. :thumbsup:
